title: Heavily Charred Kenyan Cheese Tagine
description: A deliciously charred, cheesy Kenyan dish perfect for a sick day, featuring barbeque sauce and easily served in a hot pot vessel.

ingredients.name: Cheese
ingredients.notes: A mix of cheddar and mozzarella works well.

ingredients.name: Barbeque sauce
ingredients.notes: You can use more or less depending on your preference.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: For a rich and savory flavor.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large hot pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the red bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the barbeque sauce and cheese until melted and well combined.
Serve hot, garnished with toasted bread and a side of your favorite greens.
For an added twist, top with grilled meats or vegetables.
This dish is perfect for a sick day, as the cheese and barbeque sauce provide a comforting and indulgent treat.
Feel free to customize with your favorite ingredients and spices.
